summary: DDC Enterprise filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of DDC SAVOR 13.5% Perpetual Preferred Series A shares at a $25.00 stated and liquidation value, with pricing left blank pending the underwriting agreement. Dividends accrue daily at 13.5% ($3.375 annually) plus contingent Bitcoin-linked bonus dividends up to $4.00. Shares are non-convertible, callable at $26.25 (105% of stated value) any time after issuance and at par from November 2029. Closing is conditioned on a concurrent registered direct sale of at least 1,200,000 preferred at $20.00 ($24 million) and NYSE American listing under SVOR; watch pricing, listing approval and dividend coverage given the perpetual cash-pay structure.
